facts.fact: Internet Society Pulse (from PeeringDB) lists one active IXP in Madagascar, MGIX in Antananarivo, with 4 members as of February 2026; under 1% of the 7 active domestic networks reach IXPs.

Internet Society Pulse states Madagascar has 1 active IXP, MGIX, at one physical location in Antananarivo, present in 1 of 2 population centres over 300,000, as of February 2026; the origin of members is not stated.
Internet Society Foundation says MGIX, the first Malagasy IXP, suspended operation in 2019; the iRENALA grant of USD 49,958 aims to restart it for a preliminary test period.

note: Restart is planned in this document, not stated as in service.

facts.fact: Internet Society Foundation grant record says MGIX, Madagascar's first IXP, has been suspended since 2019 and the 2024 grant of USD 49,958 to iRENALA is to restart it.

note: Restart is planned in this document, not stated as in service.

facts.fact: Internet Society says Madagascar has revived its main IXP, MGIX, and is now focused on attracting new IXP members; no date of revival or member count given, so the article date is used.

note: Only a 2020 forum recommendation to develop operational IXPs in Madagascar and a session on IXP topics; no exchange stated in service.

Starlink availability article; Madagascar is named only as a Starlink launch. The exchanges named (NAPAfrica, JINX, KIXP, LINX Nairobi, IXPN Lagos, AMS-IX Lagos) are in South Africa, Kenya and Nigeria, not MDG.
Document states nothing this study asks for Madagascar.

facts.fact: 2424.mg reports that Madagascar currently lacks a fully operational national internet exchange point, with a peering day on 28 November 2024 discussing relaunching MGiX.
The African IXP Association's undated list of exchange points, retrieved 2026-11-09, names for Madagascar: MGIX, Antananarivo.
